notes.title: - Final Note -
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

It has been a while since we've shared anything. We wanted to give an "official" announcement that Gladio will no longer be worked on. We just wanted to be clear in case there was anyone who was thinking about purchasing the game but waiting for more updates first, and in general for those who already own it. The game wasn't a huge success, but we had fun and learned a LOT in the process. It just doesn't make sense to continue investing time and resources into it further. 

[b]Thank you[/b] to everyone who has supported the game over the past 2+ years and for all of your feedback.

- 4188

notes.title: 2.0 Update Patch #1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I just released a patch that fixes some issues and addresses some early feedback.

For those of you who have been having crashes upon trying to launch the game, check to see if you have a file called "Video.sav" located at [b](yourname)>AppData>Local>gladio_v2>Saved>SaveGames>Settings>Video.sav[/b]. If that save file does exist, delete it. When you go to launch the game, it should launch in a window. You can then change your window options in-game from there. Apparently this is a known issue with other Unreal Engine 4 games. 

As for the rest of the changes, they are as follows:
[list]
[*]Added option for corpse lifetime
[*]Added option for blood decal lifetime
[*]Added option to turn off low-health screen effect
[*]Added "Victories" stat
[*]Added separate options for Invert Mouse Y and X
[*]Added separate options for Invert Controller Camera Y and X
[/list]

As always, if you have any questions or any type of feedback, please let us know! We apologize to those who have been having those startup issues, but this should help.

Thanks,
Strider

notes.title: 2.0 UPDATE
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=DI_tJGIbzvA;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone,

The 2.0 Update for Gladio is finally ready to download! In this update we have redesigned the majority of the game based on player feedback and our own. 

[u][h3]New Gameplay[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] We have completely redesigned the combat to feel better and overall be a lot more fun. We used to have a directional attack system that, while interesting, was neither reliable nor intuitive. We have replaced this with a Single and Radial system that is based off pressing or holding attack. We find this to be [u]much[/u] more fun and definitely more consistent.
[*]We have designed the Health system to be a bit more dynamic than usual. Attacking and/or utilizing a mobility mechanic will use some of your health. However, landing hits on and killing your enemies will give you back health. This means you will have to manage your health carefully.
[*]We have also added in various Crystals which add a layer of difficulty to the game. Whether it's draining your health or spawning in tougher units, you will want to dispose of these Crystals quickly.
[/list]

[u][h3]New Enemy Types[/h3][/u]
You will be able to fight against 5 different enemy types:
[list]
[*]Archer
[*]Grunt
[*]Legionary
[*]Knight
[*]Mage
[/list]
Each of these types of enemies presents a unique threat and will require a unique approach in order to defeat them.

[u][h3]New Abilities[/h3][/u]
Your Health also serves as a resource to perform various special ablilities. You can perform a [b]Palm Strike[/b] if you have enough health, and depending on how much you have the Palm Strike will have different effects. 
You can also buff your Sword when your health is full which allows you to deal much more damage.
Activating any of these abilities will consume the majority of your health though, so use them with caution.

[u][h3]Controller Support & Configurable Controls[/h3][/u]
We have added in full controller support and remapping of buttons. We have also added rebinding for Keyboard & Mouse controls.

[u][h3]Achievements[/h3][/u]
There are 46 achievements to be unlocked!

-----------------------------------------------

We have poured a lot of love into this update and we're excited for you all to experience it for yourselves. As always, let us know what you think and if you have any issues or questions.

Thank You,
Strider

notes.title: 2.0 Update Progress
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It has been some time since we’ve shared anything in regards to GLADIO. We have been hard at work and we’re excited to share a new trailer with you all! 

[previewyoutube=kNIbVCpILmI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










We also wanted to share some general info with what’s been going on and what to expect in the future:

[h3][b]Why the Radio Silence?[/b][/h3]
[list][*] We weren't completely sure what the game's identity was until recently[/list][list][*] We didn't want to mislead people and promise features or mechanics that we couldn't deliver on[/list]

[h3][b]What Took So Long?[/b][/h3]
[list][*] The first iteration of GLADIO was buggy, performance heavy, and not very much fun so we chose to remake the entire game and old mechanics from scratch[/list][list][*] There was a lot of iteration and prototyping before the game became fun to play[/list][list][*] A lot of new assets had to be made and new gameplay mechanics programmed[/list]

[h3][b]What is the Current State of the Game?[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Most of the game's combat mechanics have been completed and are being tested/balanced[/list][list][*] Maps are in development[/list][list][*] UI is in development[/list][list][*] Game modes are in development[/list]

[h3][b]Will There be Updates After Release?[/b][/h3]
[list][*] We will be updating the game based on community feedback[/list][list][*] Support for the game is planned to continue through next year[/list]  [list][*] As stated before, all future content will be free for owners of the game[/list]

We look forward to sharing more info with you soon, so be sure to stick around!

notes.title: Looking Ahead
notes.notes:
We hope you all had a great holiday! We took some time to recharge and prepare for what is to come next. 

Thank you to all who have supported us so far since September. Hopefully you have seen the potential this game has and are willing to stick with us into this year.

Many of you are probably wondering what direction we are going in from here, if in any at all. At first we were not exactly sure either, but we always had a few ideas.

We began working on the next phase of [i]Gladio[/i] last month. You can expect this to be a vast improvement from where we are currently. We have been learning constantly since the very beginning, and have been using that knowledge moving forward. 

We are going to retain our overall vision of the game that we have had since day one; a mechanically-engaging, challenging, and rewarding experience. We are going to be creating new mechanics for you to utilize and new design elements to explore.

As far as a timetable, this will take a number of months to complete. We want to make sure that the game you will be playing is as complete upon release as we can manage. 

Whenever it is released, all of you who own the game will receive the update in its entirety for [u][b]free[/b][/u]. 

In the meantime, we will still be providing support regularly. If you have any issues with the game or even any questions as to what our progress is, please contact us. 

Be sure to follow [i]Gladio[/i] even if you are considering buying it, as we will be primarily releasing teasers here! 

Email us at [b]studio4188@outlook.com[/b] with any feedback or questions!

[b]Thank you[/b] again for your support so far, and we are excited to share this next chapter with all of you.

-4188

[list]

[list]
[*]More In-Depth Behaviors
[*]More In-Depth Movement Patterns
[*]New Attack Logic
[*]New Defend Logic
[/list]
[*]Player Can No Longer Walk Through Enemy
[*]Player Attack Will Not Recoil on Enemy Armor Break (gives more advantage to Player)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33518456/67bc441c29811c00f8734a85a77fdacec62b45ec.png[/img]
[h1]Feedback[/h1]
Thank you for your feedback since the last update, we have been reading it all and a lot of it has influenced what appeared in this update. Always be sure to tell us about your experience and if you have any ideas. 
We also [b][u]thank you[/u] again for your patience[/b] as this update took a bit longer than we indicated previously. Developing a game is quite the task, and issues arise all too frequently during the process. We will always let you know of our progress and when to expect updates.

As always, please be sure to let us know if you are experiencing any issues whatsoever. There is a new Bug Report Thread in the Community Hub which should be the primary place for you to tell us about any bugs. You are also encouraged to leave a general post or email us at [b]studio4188@outlook.com[/b] with any other feedback.

Thank you again, from the two of us here at 4188. We have lots planned for [i]Gladio[/i] and your support allows us to keep working on it like this. We hope you enjoy this update!

-4188
